expect.question: The NHS's National Programme for IT (NPfIT), which cost the UK government more than £10 billion before being dismantled in 2011, is most often cited as a failure of which specific kind?

set.question: The NHS's National Programme for IT (NPfIT), dismantled in 2011 at an estimated cost of £9.8 billion, is most often cited as a failure of which specific kind?

edits.claim: quiz: NPfIT cost more than £10 billion
edits.src: UK Public Accounts Committee HC 294 (2013): estimated cost £9.8bn (likely more) — "more than £10 billion" not supported by the primary source
